surveyed.source: OSM node 4370459609 (Hildo Krop 1931, bridge 420); group read from Wikimedia Commons photographs (Alf van Beem public domain; Marcelmulder68 CC BY-SA 3.0 nl); the facing 180 stands on panorama TMX7316010203-001170_pano_0000_000080 (back of the boy against the Amstel hotel buildings; the girl is assumed to match); pier height (2.3 m) and group size are estimates scaled off the girl head

attribution.title: Kinderbrug: Boy with rabbits (Hildo Krop) - reconstruction from photographs
attribution.author: Map Recall; sculpture by Hildo Krop (1931); figure reconstructed from photographs by Paul van Galen
attribution.modifications: Figure reconstructed (TripoSR single-view) from Wikimedia Commons photographs: "Brug over Boerenwetering beeldhouwwerk tussen Churchilllaan en Muzenplein - Amsterdam - 20011022 - RCE.jpg" by Paul van Galen (CC BY-SA 4.0, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Brug_over_Boerenwetering_beeldhouwwerk_tussen_Churchilllaan_en_Muzenplein_-_Amsterdam_-_20011022_-_RCE.jpg). Decimated to about 6,000 triangles per figure in the kit's material, no photo colour; plinth, pier and setting are the original low-poly kit model. Provenance: scripts/sculptures/rebuild-sources/kinderbrug-jongen-konijnen.json.
